description_en: User retrieves reminders created on Tmall Genie devices.
description_zh: 用户获取在天猫精灵设备上创建的提醒
name: GetReminder

fields.help_en: The unique ID of the reminder
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: Indicates whether this invocation is for debug purposes
fields.name: is_debug

parameters.help_en: Input parameters for the service request
parameters.name: payload

fields.help_en: User identifier, set to either userOpenId or userUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Type of the User ID  
- OPEN_ID: The default User ID identifier.  
- UNION_ID: The organization-dimension User ID identifier. This value is available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie Skills Application Open Platform
fields.help_zh:
用户Id的类型
- OPEN_ID：默认的用户ID标识。
- UNION_ID：组织维度的用户ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用平台申请过组织后才会有该值
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Tmall Genie, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.
- PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used for the Android application customer ingest endpoint.
- SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used for the cloud-based ingest endpoint
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取天猫精灵的用户标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型。
- PACKAGE_NAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型。
- SKILL_ID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
Value corresponding to the encoding type.  

- When the encoding type is SKILLID, the value is the application's Skill ID.  
- When the encoding type is PACKAGENAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值。

- 编码类型是SKILLID时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
- 编码类型是PACKAGENAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Organization ID. Required when **IdType** is set to **UNION_ID**
fields.name: organization_id

fields.help_en: Device ID, set to either deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Type of device ID.  
- OPEN_ID: The default device ID.  
- UNION_ID: Organization-level device ID, available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Platform
fields.help_zh:

- UNION_ID: 组织维度的设备ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用平台申请过组织后才会有该值

- When the encoding type is SKILLID, the value is the application's Skill ID.
- When the encoding type is PACKAGENAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app

编码类型对应的值。

- 编码类型是SKILLID时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
- 编码类型是PACKAGENAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
